entity.jjk.mahoraga: Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga
item.jjk.armor_set.geto_kesa.bonus: 2 pieces: curses ignore you unless you strike first
item.jjk.armor_set.gojo_outfit.bonus: Blindfold: -15% CE cost (Six Eyes). Full set: -25% cost, +15% regen
item.jjk.armor_set.nanami_suit.bonus: Full set: +30% melee damage at night (overtime)
item.jjk.armor_set.sukuna_kimono.bonus: +10% technique damage per piece. Requires 10 of Sukuna's fingers
item.jjk.armor_set.toji_outfit.bonus: Heavenly Restriction: +6% speed and +1.5 damage per piece
item.jjk.black_rope.tooltip: Unravels techniques and strips the target's buffs.
item.jjk.ce_bottle.tooltip: Restores %s%% of your max cursed energy.
item.jjk.ce_shard.tooltip: Crystallized cursed energy. Eat to restore 20 CE.
item.jjk.clan_scroll.tooltip: Reveals the bloodline you were born into.
item.jjk.cursed_energy_scroll.tooltip: Unseals your Innate Technique and the depth of your cursed energy.
item.jjk.cursed_fragment.tooltip: A shard of a curse's body. Used to craft talismans and tools.
item.jjk.death_painting.absorbed: The Death Painting's blood becomes yours.
item.jjk.death_painting.tooltip: One of the nine Death Paintings. Absorb it for cursed energy.
item.jjk.dragon_bone.tooltip: Stores impact you take and releases it on your next hit.
item.jjk.heavenly_restriction_scroll.too: A binding vow struck at birth. Very rarely, it takes.
item.jjk.inverted_spear_of_heaven.toolti: Nullifies any cursed technique it touches.
item.jjk.playful_cloud.tooltip: Three-section staff. Pure physical force, no technique.
item.jjk.prison_realm.tooltip: Right-click a creature to seal it away for 30s (bosses: 12s).
item.jjk.slaughter_demon.tooltip: Deals heavy bonus damage to curses.
item.jjk.special_grade_object.tooltip: Sealed and wrapped in talismans. Absorbable, or a crafting core.
item.jjk.split_soul_katana.tooltip: Cuts the soul directly; armor is no defense.
item.jjk.student_id.tooltip: Right-click to register it. Sorcerers only trade with registered students.
item.jjk.sukuna_finger.tooltip: One of twenty. A special grade cursed object. Do not eat.
item.jjk.talisman.tooltip: Carry it to block a single cursed technique hit.
jjk.boss.hanami.phase2: The earth itself rises against you.
jjk.boss.jogo.phase3: "Domain Expansion: Coffin of the Iron Mountain!"
jjk.boss.mahito.phase2: "I've finally figured out the shape of my soul!"
jjk.clan.clanless.desc: Commoner blood. No inheritance, but a small bonus to everything (+5%).
jjk.clan.fujiwara.desc: A Heian-era lineage. +20% CE regeneration; leans toward Straw Doll, Ratio and Disaster Flames.
jjk.clan.gojo.desc: Six Eyes: -30% CE costs, +15% regen and you perceive others' cursed energy. Favors Limitless.
jjk.clan.inumaki.desc: The snake-and-fangs crest. Almost always inherits Cursed Speech.
jjk.clan.kamo.desc: +10% max CE. Very likely to inherit Blood Manipulation.
jjk.clan.ryomen.desc: The blood of the King of Curses. +10% max CE, +15% technique damage, strongly favors Shrine.
jjk.clan.zenin.desc: +25% weapon damage. Strong chance of Ten Shadows or Projection Sorcery.
jjk.command.info: %s — %s | Technique: %s | Clan: %s | CE: %s (%s) | Restriction: %s | CE %s, regen %s/s | XP %s, curses exorcised %s | Abilities: %s
jjk.heavenly_restriction.cursed_energy.d: A frail body, in exchange for vast cursed energy, faster regeneration and far longer range.
jjk.heavenly_restriction.none.desc: The vow found nothing to bind. Your body stays as it was.
jjk.heavenly_restriction.physical.desc: Zero cursed energy and no technique, in exchange for monstrous strength, speed, durability and senses. Curses cannot sense you, and you can see them without glasses.
jjk.message.absorb_full: You can't hold any more curses.
jjk.message.absorb_no_target: Look at a cursed spirit to absorb it.
jjk.message.absorb_too_strong: That curse is too strong. Weaken it first!
jjk.message.amplification_blocks: You can't use your technique while amplifying your domain.
jjk.message.domain_clash_lost: Your domain was overwritten by a stronger one!
jjk.message.domain_locked: Your domain has not yet taken shape. (Reach Grade 1)
jjk.message.finger_rejected: Your body has no cursed energy to hold it. It burns.
jjk.message.infinity_down: Infinity collapses: out of cursed energy.
jjk.message.kimono_rejects: The kimono rejects you. (Requires %s of Sukuna's fingers)
jjk.message.mahoraga_adapted: Mahoraga has adapted to that attack!
jjk.message.mahoraga_summoned: With this treasure, I summon... Mahoraga has no master. Survive it!
jjk.message.mahoraga_tamed: You exorcised Mahoraga. From now on, it answers your call.
jjk.message.no_ability: You have no ability to use.
jjk.message.no_scrolls: You have no more scrolls of that kind.
jjk.message.prison_realm_sealed: You have been sealed inside the Prison Realm!
jjk.message.rct_locked: You have not learned Reverse Cursed Technique.
jjk.message.restriction_rejects_scroll: Your Heavenly Restriction rejects cursed techniques.
jjk.message.takeover_end: Sukuna recedes. You are yourself again... for now.
jjk.message.takeover_start: "Know your place, fool." Sukuna has taken over!
jjk.message.welcome: A sorcerer's path begins. Unroll your scrolls to awaken your technique and bloodline.
jjk.mission.already_active: You already have an active mission.
jjk.mission.exorcise: Exorcise %s curses of %s or stronger (%s done).
jjk.mission.need_finger: You need one of Sukuna's fingers.
jjk.mission.ready: Mission complete! Report to any sorcerer.
jjk.mission.retrieve_finger: Retrieve one of Sukuna's fingers and hand it over for sealing.
jjk.npc.gojo.greeting: Yo! Don't worry, I'm the strongest. Want to get stronger too? I can teach you a thing or two.
jjk.npc.gojo.train: Reverse Cursed Technique: multiply negative energy by negative energy. Black Flash: hit at the exact same instant. Easy, right?
jjk.npc.inumaki.greeting: Salmon! ...Tuna mayo. (He seems to be offering help.)
jjk.npc.inumaki.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.npc.maki.greeting: Need gear? Cursed tools are my specialty. Don't break them.
jjk.npc.maki.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.npc.megumi.greeting: ...You're from Jujutsu High? Keep it quick, there are curses nearby.
jjk.npc.megumi.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.npc.mission_offer: I have a job for you: %s Reward: %s jujutsu experience, cursed fragments and supplies.
jjk.npc.nanami.greeting: It's almost six. Let's settle this efficiently, without overtime.
jjk.npc.nanami.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.npc.need_id: Show a registered Jujutsu High Student ID to trade.
jjk.npc.nobara.greeting: Finally, someone useful. Got any work, or are you just sightseeing?
jjk.npc.nobara.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.npc.panda.greeting: I'm a panda. Don't think too hard about it. Want some talismans?
jjk.npc.panda.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.npc.refuse_exiled: "You reek of Sukuna. Get away from me."
jjk.npc.yaga.greeting: Why do you want to be a jujutsu sorcerer? Answer that, and I'll train you.
jjk.npc.yaga.train: Training is not for the faint of heart. Show me you've earned it.
jjk.npc.yuji.greeting: Hey! You're a sorcerer too? Let's exorcise some curses together!
jjk.npc.yuji.train: Train? Talk to Gojo or Principal Yaga.
jjk.technique.black_flash_affinity.desc: No technique to speak of, but the sparks of black flash come to you naturally.
jjk.technique.blood_manipulation.desc: The Kamo clan's art: Piercing Blood, Supernova and Flowing Red Scale convergence.
jjk.technique.boogie_woogie.desc: Clap to swap places with anything that has cursed energy.
jjk.technique.ce_reinforcement.desc: Raw reinforcement of the body with cursed energy. Simple and reliable.
jjk.technique.comedian.desc: If you find it funny, it happens. Reality bends to the punchline.
jjk.technique.construction.desc: Create matter from cursed energy. Exhausting, but versatile.
jjk.technique.cursed_speech.desc: Words become commands: Don't Move, Blast Away, Crush. Strains the throat.
jjk.technique.cursed_spirit_manipulation: Absorb defeated curses and release them as your own. Culminates in Uzumaki.
jjk.technique.disaster_flames.desc: Volcanic cursed flames: Ember Insects and Maximum: Meteor. Domain: Coffin of the Iron Mountain.
jjk.technique.idle_transfiguration.desc: Touch the soul and reshape the body. Domain: Self-Embodiment of Perfection.
jjk.technique.limitless.desc: Bring infinity into reality. Infinity, Blue, Red and Hollow Purple. Domain: Unlimited Void.
jjk.technique.none.desc: You have cursed energy, but no innate technique to channel it.
jjk.technique.projection_sorcery.desc: Move in 24 frames per second. Anyone who breaks the rules freezes in a frame.
jjk.technique.puppet_manipulation.desc: Fight through cursed corpses and mechanized puppets. Ultra Cannon!
jjk.technique.ratio.desc: Force a weak point at the 7:3 line of any target. Overtime strengthens you.
jjk.technique.shrine.desc: The King of Curses' technique. Dismantle, Cleave and Fuga. Domain: Malevolent Shrine.
jjk.technique.straw_doll.desc: Nails and a hammer: Resonance strikes from afar, Hairpin detonates.
jjk.technique.ten_shadows.desc: Summon shikigami from your shadow, up to the Eight-Handled Sword Divergent Sila Divine General Mahoraga. Domain: Chimera Shadow Garden.
jjk.train.black_flash_learned: Your sense for Black Flash sharpens. (+3% Black Flash chance)
jjk.train.rct_learned: You learned Reverse Cursed Technique! (G to heal)
jjk.train.rct_requirements: Requires Grade 1 and 3 Special Grade Cursed Objects.
